correctness.rationale: Frame is Parseval by Fourier orthogonality. Erasure operator I-(2m)^(-1)AA*, so worst lower eigenvalue reduces to max Gram eigenvalue. Parity unitary gives pure-parity 2x2 block L_plus=(9+sqrt(9+8|T|²))/2 and mixed tridiagonal B(t). Root projection selects consecutive same-parity sites; Sylvester minors (2,4,12), (2,2,4), (3,4,14) prove strict mixed bound; m=3 noninjective two cases, m>=4 all retained frames positive. Independent full all-triple computation m=3..12 verifies equality counts and values; proof is all-m.
